description: ColPackAgent-assisted scientific study driven by a research program (demo/specs/assisted_study_program.md). The program encodes the methodology (system size, sample_steps floor, OP choice rules, reporting format) while leaving the scientific choices (composition, pressure range, hypotheses) to the agent — Karpathy-style autoresearch.

tasks.description: Open scientific question: study the phase transition of 2D hard disks and hard squares in the NPT ensemble. Agent picks composition (pure disks, pure squares, or a mixture), designs the sweep, selects order parameters, and synthesizes a scientific conclusion.
user_messages: Read and execute the research program at `demo/specs/assisted_study_program.md`. Follow its methodology constraints exactly; the scientific choices it leaves open are yours to make. Run autonomously and produce the final summary the program describes.
expected_outcomes: The agent reads the research program file before starting any simulation work.
The agent honors the methodology constraints — N ≥ 500 particles, sample_steps ≥ 5e5 explicitly overridden (not the ColPack default), at least 6 pressure points.
The agent picks composition (disks / squares / mixture), pressure range, and an appropriate orientational order parameter (ψ_6 for disks, P_4 for squares).
The agent runs setup, plan, execute, and analyze autonomously, iterating with a second sweep if the first does not resolve the transition.
The agent produces a final summary in the format requested by the program: composition + rationale, sweep parameters, φ(P), OP(P), identified P*, caveats.

skills.description: Production ColPack skill from the project root agent folder
